name: Cassandra Wright
source:
A student at the local college and a friend of [url=https://vndb.org/c174069]John[/url]'s sister, [url=https://vndb.org/c174100]Holly[/url] . Though she has been over a few times, John has interacted with her very little. Somewhat snobbish due to her social status, she always has a maid, [url=https://vndb.org/c174115]Elizabeth[/url], with her wherever she goes.
